title: River Review Skill Viewpoints Schema
description: Experimental data-only schema for reusable review knowledge owned by a selected Skill. It does not define routing, evaluator choice, policy, gate actions, or executable behavior.

id.description: Unique identifier within the owning Skill. Duplicate ids are rejected by the loader.

activatesOn.description: Experimental signal vocabulary that may activate this viewpoint. These values do not perform routing or execute code.

question.description: Review question to verify. It must not assert that a violation already exists.

requiredEvidence.description: Evidence categories required before the evaluator can answer the review question.

evidenceHints.description: Optional evidence categories that help resolve the question but are not mandatory.

falsePositiveGuards.description: Known applicability exclusions. They are knowledge only and do not define gate policy.

version.description: Experimental schema revision. This is not yet a Stable Interface.

skillId.description: ID of the Skill that owns these viewpoints.
